slice: RPP-5cr selected raw ACSH history DXF reexport

baseline.priorFailure: Actual DXF import then reexport refused EvaluationGraph owner as unresolved/unrepresentable
baseline.cause: DXF publishes typed ACSH identity shells plus raw bodies; the CLI retained the shells but discarded their raw bodies, so no safe history-owner serialization route existed

scope.source: Actual DXF imports of locally authored typed BOX/history outputs with a historyless solid neighbor and distinct marker payloads
scope.target: Exact matching source revision, either ASCII or binary

implementation.capture: CLI-owned bounded raw ACSH/EvaluationGraph records and one successful DXF import receipt: generation/version, callback/history/group/byte counts and sticky failure
implementation.closure: Unique modeler -> history -> EvaluationGraph -> BOX -> material roles, paired typed identity shells and graph fields, unique custom classes/counts, no orphan/shared/duplicate closures
implementation.identityShellAuthority: DXF typed ACSH callbacks do not decode the native field body; raw groups own the body. Require paired identity and supported empty shell state, not native BODY DTO interpretation
implementation.unsupportedCommonMetadata: Extra application/XDATA/reactor/extension fields outside this explicit profile refuse; none are silently dropped
implementation.extensionGraph: Only validated selected ACSH owners/expressions enter the existing bounded inventory; indexed owner lookup, no arbitrary raw handle whitelist
implementation.snapshot: Freeze admitted raw fields/raw spellings, source generation, receipt and DXF class metadata. Recheck typed/raw roles and source context during callbacks, staged inspection and finalization
implementation.adoptedSectionOwnership: At admission raw ACDSDATA source is complete and unchanged. During codec write it is exclusively adopted; caller moved-from raw-section container must remain empty. Do not interpret legitimate adoption as source loss
implementation.rawIdentityContract: Reserve raw self keys and retain them unchanged; generic raw writers do not publish typed source-object bindings. Prove exact staged fields and final unique name/OBJECTS/owner/target records using the actual raw contract
implementation.stageInspector: Ordered primitive fields, mapped self/owner/reference values, subclasses, integers and bit-exact doubles. Selected record inventory must be exact; no per-file record model retained
implementation.finalInspector: Admitted source still unchanged, stage inspection completed, raw self unchanged, exact record identity and owner, every self/owner/target emitted exactly once
